The '''Z-95ER Headhunter''' was a common [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] variant built for extended missions.<ref name="SWS" /> It was equipped with additional [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] tanks for extra range.<ref name="DB" />
